name: Twango1
summary: Twango1 (TWANGO1.WAD) is a 2021 deathmatch megawad community project led by OpenRift. It contains 32 levels that try to keep the spirit of the original DWANGO compilations and was made by Doomworld members over the course of two months. It is fully vanilla compatible and can be run on any multiplayer source port. In addition to the main PWAD, there is also a WAD with widescreen graphics in the zip. Twango1 features numerous custom textures, a DeHackEd patch that replaces the intermission text with humorous additions, and a custom status bar. A sequel for Ultimate Doom, called The Ultimate TWANGO, was released the next year in 2022.
